official_definition: Flash - Ultra Advent: During Advent (Either Attack Step) By putting 20px from your Reserve/Trash to a "Superstar"/"Galaxian" family Spirit you control, stack this from your hand onto your target Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Ultra Advent] or [Ultra Advent: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Ultra Advent]", "give [Ultra Advent]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
